title: [Feature Request]: Listing out all agents in a GroupChatManager
body:
### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

I'm not sure if this is currently possible, but it would be useful to list out all the agents present in a `GroupChatManager`. 

### Describe the solution you'd like

I was thinking of something similar to `agent_by_name` in `GroupChat`
```python
def agent_by_name(self, name: str) -> Optional[Agent]:
        """Returns the agent with a given name."""
        return self.present_agents().get(name)

def present_agents(self) -> Dict[str, Agent]:
        agents = dict()
        for agent in self._groupchat.agents:
            if not isinstance(agent, GroupChatManager):
                agents[agent.name] = agent
            else:
                agents.update(agent.present_agents())
        return agents
```
I haven't tested this implementation but should be close.

### Additional context

This could be useful when you're defining teams in different modules

--- file_a
```python
def some_team():
    member1 = AssistantAgent(...)
    member2 = UserProxyAgent(...)

    gc = GroupChat(agents=[member1, member2], ...)
    return GroupChatManager(groupchat=gc, ...)
```

--- file_b
```python
import file_a

team1 = file_a.some_team()

# I need access to the agents in team1
agents = team1.present_agents()
```

## Why are these changes needed?
<!-- Please give a short summary of the change and the problem this solves. -->
Adds the capability to get all the agents in a given a `GroupChatManager`. Improves quality of life for the following use case:

--- file_a
```python
def some_team():
    member1 = AssistantAgent(...)
    member2 = UserProxyAgent(...)

    gc = GroupChat(agents=[member1, member2], ...)
    return GroupChatManager(groupchat=gc, ...)
```

--- file_b
```python
import file_a

team1 = file_a.some_team()

# I need access to the agents in team1
agents = team1.all_agents()
```
[Example use case.](https://gist.github.com/WaelKarkoub/9b5d8324d6abc334efcc4d2b5ba5ae66)

## Related issue number

Closes #1632
